title: Why the quantification of modularity effects remains an issue for modular product families
core_idea: Investigate why quantifying the effects of modularity in product families is difficult, with a focus on data quality, availability, and management practices in industrial settings, and outline research directions—such as examining accounting systems and developing structured data management frameworks including AI—to improve data quality and quantifiability for modular product development.
tldr: The paper examines challenges that prevent reliable quantification of modularity effects—centering on data-related and management issues in industry—and proposes exploring accounting impacts and structured data/AI frameworks to enhance data quality and support data-driven modularity decisions.
